messages:
support_jordan: FYI customer acme-inc reporting intermittent 5xx + client timeouts since ~11:58 UTC. spike peaked at 12:05. tickets: #AC-4382.
infra_bot: ALERT: hosted-gateway returned 5xx rate > 1.5% over 3m for cluster hosted-prod-eu (ids: p-gw-03,p-gw-07).
oncall_ryan: I'm pulling traces, starting distributed trace correlation now. can someone grab their request ids from the customer payloads?
support_jordan: customer sent sample request-ids: rq_8a3f, rq_8a4b, rq_8a6d. They say requests hang ~15-20s then 502/504. They also saw "billing revoked" errors briefly.
eng_sre_maya: grabbing logs for those request ids. initial look: upstream auth-proxy returned 502 -> gateway 504 when proxy retried. small cluster of backend 503s at same time window.
carla_product: customer says this started right after they enabled usage-based billing flag in console. they toggled at 11:55 UTC. could be related.
cust_success_lee: confirmed with customer — they flipped the flag, then started seeing failures across several endpoints hitting our hosted inference API.
eng_sre_maya: repro attempt from our side: run curl to /v1/generate with their api key (redacted) from eu test runner. intermittent 504s at ~15s. can't repro on all calls, but pattern matches.
eng_sre_maya: curl snippet used:```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -w "\nHTTP_CODE:%{http_code} TIME_TOTAL:%{time_total}\n"
```
eng_sre_maya: local logs around rq_8a4b:```json
{"ts":"2025-12-12T12:05:01Z","req":"rq_8a4b","stage":"auth-proxy","msg":"token refresh in progress, queued request"}
{"ts":"2025-12-12T12:05:16Z","req":"rq_8a4b","stage":"gateway","msg":"upstream timeout after 15s"}
{"ts":"2025-12-12T12:05:16Z","req":"rq_8a4b","stage":"client","msg":"client timeout returned 504"}
```
oncall_ryan: looks like an auth token rotation + billing check path introduced a small window where requests were queued and then retried, causing head-of-line timeouts under load. recent deploy to auth-proxy at 11:50 had change: parallel token refresh + synchronous billing check (was asynchronous before).
eng_sre_maya: confirmed config change in deploy tag auth-proxy@v2.3.0: billing middleware now performs KMS lookup + billing entitlement check inline. increased p99 latency for auth-proxy from 45ms -> 320ms in staging traces.
carla_product: that deploy was intended to close a billing inconsistency bug. but unintended latency regression is causing gateway to hit 15s timeout window under burst.
support_jordan: mitigation? customer needs urgent relief.
oncall_ryan: immediate mitigation executed: rolled auth-proxy back to v2.2.7 on hosted-prod-eu at 12:15 UTC, enabled fallback route to model redwood-7b-quant (lighter path) for acme-inc, and temporarily bumped gateway upstream timeout to 22s for affected route.
infra_bot: ACTION: rollback complete on p-gw-03/p-gw-07 at 12:18 UTC. circuit-breaker opened for auth-proxy v2.3.0.
eng_sre_maya: after rollback, error rate for acme-inc dropped to 0.15% within 6 minutes. p95 latency back to baseline. customer reports immediate improvement at 12:24.
cust_success_lee: customer confirms calls are succeeding again and they've paused the billing flag toggle. they want root cause and next steps.
carla_product: high-level RCA: auth-proxy v2.3.0 introduced synchronous billing/KMS path, which increased auth-proxy p99 latency and caused transient queuing + gateway timeouts during token refresh windows. change lacked perf regression gating for hosted-prod.
eng_sre_maya: postmortem action items: 1) revert sync billing change in auth-proxy and ship an async design (owner: @eng_sre_maya, ETA 3 days). 2) Add perf regression test for auth-proxy token refresh path (owner: @oncall_ryan, ETA 1 week). 3) Add dashboard alert for auth-proxy p99 > 200ms (owner: @infra_alerts, ETA 2 days). 4) Create a playbook entry for "billing flag toggle" customer ops with rollback steps (owner: @carla_product, ETA 5 days).
support_jordan: also add step to ops runbook: when customer toggles billing flags, auto-notify SRE & CS for 15m post-toggle. owner: @cust_success_lee.
oncall_ryan: follow-ups: schedule canary with seed traffic for any billing-path changes, run 2h soak in eu region before broad deploy.
eng_sre_maya: small followup: investigate why KMS lookup latency spikes correlated exactly with token rotation windows — maybe KMS client caching TTL misconfigured. ticket created: INF-7753. owner: @eng_sre_maya.
carla_product: communications: send customer a summary + apology and share timeline + remediation steps. I'll handle.
support_jordan: temporary customer credits requested for downtime window. Finance OK pending postmortem.
oncall_ryan: closing notes: incident contained via rollback at 12:18, verified fix by 12:24. monitoring to stay elevated for 24h. posting full postmortem to #postmortems by tomorrow EOD.
eng_sre_maya: logs and trace artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-incidents/1758889999 for the postmortem.
carla_product: anything else?
support_jordan: none from support. archived the ticket after customer confirmation at 12:40.
infra_bot: REMINDER: assign codeowners to INF-7753 within 48h to avoid stale RCA.
carla_product: noted. closing thread for triage -> will ping when postmortem draft ready. :white_check_mark:
